title: T02c — Unavailable endpoint waits or expires within budgets; policy-approved cloud path; Pi capability route
goal: Unavailable endpoint waits or expires within budgets; policy-approved cloud path; Pi capability route.
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Unavailable endpoint waits or expires within budgets; policy-approved cloud path; Pi capability route
Model endpoint and execution worker are selected independently
No silent fallback or implicit permission
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Implemented F-006-T08 (T02c): bounded remote endpoint waiting and expiry within waitBudgetMs, bounded same-endpoint retry within time/token/concurrency limits, policy-approved cloud path, and Pi capability route in 0.75 h agent (stated; PR #420).
